periods.label: Fri 2 Oct
periods.text: Variable below 10 knots becoming north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon. Winds reaching up to 20 knots offshore south of Moruya Heads in the late evening. Around 1 metre. Northeasterly 1.5 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres around midday. Southerly around 1 metre. Cloudy. 95% chance of rain.

periods.label: Sat 3 Oct
periods.text: Northerly 15 to 20 knots, reaching up to 25 knots offshore during the afternoon and evening. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres around midday. Southerly below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning, then decreasing to 1.5 metres during the afternoon. Northeasterly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore by early evening. Cloudy. 95% chance of rain. The chance of a thunderstorm.

periods.label: Sun 4 Oct

Northeasterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning. Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the morning.
